notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for atomic rejection of invalid single-module Create Federation Execution requests. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, base and invalid FOM modules, endpoint, logical-time selection, and callback configuration. It verifies that rejected creates do not reserve the federation name and that a later valid create, join, lookup, resign, destroy, and disconnect lifecycle succeeds without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.
